title: CLAVES
creator: SamuelGremaud
source_format: Public Freesound high-quality MP3 preview; not the original lossless file
source_notes: Original WAV: 48000 Hz / 24-bit stereo. Wooden claves recorded with a Zoom H4N Pro. First strike extracted.
processing: FFmpeg decode to mono 44100 Hz float32; extract specified frame range; fixed 0.5 gain to prevent MP3 overshoot clipping; quantize to PCM16 (multiply by 32767 and truncate). No normalization, EQ, denoising, pitch shift or time stretching added.
